title: Experiment
description: A running service experiment in the AI Venture Factory. Created when an Opportunity is promoted to building. Owns the per-service folder under services/<slug>/. Update this record whenever stage, cost/gain, or last_signal changes.

slug.description: Kebab-case identifier used as the services/<slug>/ folder name. Lowercase letters, digits, hyphens. 3-50 chars. Must start with a letter.

opportunity_id.description: ULID of the Opportunity this experiment was promoted from.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 with timezone offset. IDT (+03:00) preferred.

current_stage.description: Mirrors status.md current_stage. Single source of truth lives here; status.md is the human-readable view.

owner_agent.description: Name of the agent currently responsible for moving this experiment forward (e.g., 'Builder agent', 'Delivery agent', 'Outreach agent').

build_decision.description: Snapshot of the decision that promoted this Opportunity to an Experiment.

decided_by_agent.description: Agent that recommended the build (operator approval still required per approval_policy.yaml).

model_used.description: Exact model ID used to generate the rationale (e.g., claude-opus-4-7).

rationale_summary.description: Short summary of why this passed the Build Decision gate. Full rationale lives in the experiment folder.

operator_approved_at.description: Set when the operator clicks approve. Until set, the experiment is provisional.

cost_gain.description: Latest cost/gain snapshot driving kill/continue/scale decisions. Recomputed by the Reporting agent at least daily.

cost_estimate_usd.description: Cumulative cost to date in USD: compute + tools + leads + operator hours costed at the operator's rate.

gain_estimate_usd.description: Cumulative gross revenue minus refunds in USD. May be 0 pre-launch; may be negative if refunds > revenue.

ratio.description: gain_estimate_usd / cost_estimate_usd. Convention: if cost is 0, set ratio to null. Compare against thresholds in config/cost_gain_model.yaml.

last_signal.description: Most recent material event observed for this experiment. Anything that should bubble into the daily summary.

kind.description: Short label of the signal type, e.g., 'cohort_sent', 'first_reply', 'first_paid', 'refund_issued', 'qa_failed', 'sla_breach'.

value.description: Signal payload. Free-form: number, string, or small object. Keep under ~1 KB serialised.

kill_threshold_breached.description: True when any kill condition in config/cost_gain_model.yaml is met. Reporting agent sets this; operator decision required to actually move stage to 'killed'.

next_review_at.description: When the next kill/continue/scale review is due (IDT preferred). Reporting agent surfaces overdue reviews in the daily summary.

parent_experiment_id.description: If this is a spinoff or pivoted version of an earlier experiment, the parent's ULID.
